channel.title: The Dig — Spin qubit devices and figures of merit
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Spin qubit devices and figures of merit preset. Today's ranked reading list leads with 2611.27140 on FPGA-in-loop drift tracking for spin-qubit tuning, 2611.27927 on transpilation-aware multi-vendor QPU scheduling, and 2611.25579 on syndrome-based recalibration via gate-error amplification, all directly relevant to automated calibration and calibration-aware job placement. The skim tier then covers classical hardware for real-time QEC in 2611.26447, non-binary detector error models in 2611.26395, optimized Trotter-Suzuki schemes in 2611.27896, and Trotter-decomposition scheduling in 2611.26884, which are useful for the machine's error-correction and simulation routes but less directly tied to operating the spin-qubit system.
